text: Cloud Security and Compliance Frameworks — an orientation to how cloud platforms track compliance, not legal or compliance advice for your specific organization.
Microsoft Defender for Cloud's Regulatory compliance dashboard tracks multiple standards at once. Selecting one shows its controls; selecting a control shows exactly what's being checked.
Every control splits into automated checks the platform runs itself, and manual items that need a person to attest, with evidence attached.
A failed control resolves all the way down to real resources — here, the exact virtual machines currently missing disk encryption.
The shape repeats across every framework: a standard defines controls, controls get assessed — automated or manual — and that rolls up into a compliance score.
Next up: Azure Policy — the mechanism behind many of those automated checks.
